Type like this makes normal type.

To code: option+command+i

Install packages
```{r}
install.packages("tidyverse")
install.packages("janitor")
```

Load packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Load Data
```{r}
data <- read_csv("data/all_lots_okay_to_dissect.csv") %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() 
```


Filter our data
```{r}
hybama_only <- data %>% 
  filter(scientific_name %in% c("Hybognathus amarus"))
```

Plot
```{r}
hybama_only <- data %>%
  filter(scientific_name %in% c("Hybognathus amarus"))


Plot
```{r}
hist(hybama_only$individual_count)

ggplot(hybama_only,
       aes(x = year_collected, y = individual_count)) + geom_point()
